Vamsi's AI Travel Planner validates coordinates at render time instead of in the Zod schema because `streamObject` validates the entire object. If strict `lat`/`lng` bounds were enforced in the Zod schema, a single bad number returned by the model would reject the entire itinerary rather than a single component. Filtering the coordinates in `ItineraryView` keeps failures local, resulting in one missing pin instead of an empty screen.

(Sources: AI Travel Planner README)
